name: znetwork_dplay_get_enumerated_session_name_by_index
description: zNetworkDPlay::GetEnumeratedSessionNameByIndex fetches an enumerated DirectPlay session cache entry and returns its duplicated sessionName pointer, or null when the entry is missing.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The plan keeps Reconstructed limited because prior Binary Ninja notes record a decompiler null-return rendering limitation; assembly and typed source contract are sufficient for functional acceptance.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48a2c0 validates the __fastcall ECX=entryIndex ABI, global g_zNetwork_EnumeratedSessionList lookup through zArchiveList::GetAt, null return when no cache entry exists, and sessionName return from cache offset 0x38.
The native smoke builds a circular enumerated-session list and verifies index 0 and 1 sessionName returns plus null returns for an out-of-range index and null global list.
